title: Nationaal Jeugddebat 1995
authors: Webers, E., Interview bv * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
contributors: Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport * Rijswijk (research initiator)
descriptions: The study makes an inventory of how young people feel on a range of topics, in anticipation of an organized debate between national politicians and Dutch youth in 1995. Topics cover schooling, jobs and working conditions, living environment and place to live, health services, crime, role of the army in peace time, public transport, own means of transport, road safety, environmental issues and negative effects of new planned infrastructure, own sources of income, age for minimum wages, bursary system for higher education / open ended questions invite for suggestions to politicians / two concluding subjects are local democracy and general political interest, and evaluation by young people government information campaigns. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education
